entityDescription:
Aero Enterprise is specialized in the sustainable inspection and analysis of surfaces on primarily vertical (industrial) objects of all kinds. A big focus is set on (offshore)wind power plants.
The quality assurance system consists of flight robots, mobile ground stations, client-based analysis software and a database. In parallel to the high-resolution digital images, infrared data are also recorded, which can give an insight into the deeper layers of an object. The obtained information is GNSS- and object-referenced and is imaged for the customer in an analysis software in a virtual 3D environment.
Numerous tools allow the information to be qualified and classified, supported by AI. The digital recording of the actual states of the objects allows for the first time an "objectification", which is often subjectively judged by human beings, and absolute information of old and new data can be used as part of a change management.
The software and database form the ideal basis for the connection to industry 4.0 and integration of the data into an existing ERP environment of our customers.
We also provide a partner-program (SaaS), where experts and specialists in the wind energy business can use their own drones for data acquisition in combination with our Software package to do the analysis of the data. Finally with one-click a partner-branded report is generated to get situational awareness of their assets.
NOTE:
Since July 2020 AE is also part of Buss Energy Group ( www.buss-group.com ) and WINDEA ( www.windea.de ). In this embedded international consortium we are able to provide a large variety of extra services starting from the planning, projecting, installing ( with harbour- and ship management) inspection and quality control, maintenance & repair till to the end-of live phase with decommissioning of offshore plants.

entityName: University of Zagreb Faculty of Geodesy - Chair of Photogrammetry and Remote Sensing
entityDescription:
The employees of the Chair of Photogrammetry and Remote Sensing actively participate in teaching on all study programs at the Faculty of Geodesy, University of Zagreb (undergraduate, graduate and postgraduate specialist and postgraduate doctoral studies) and in the lifelong education program of the Faculty of Geodesy. The employees of the Chair teach classes in the fields of photogrammetry, remote sensing, and geoinformation systems (GIS). Teaching processes include the usage of the commercial and open-source software for digital image processing in the fields of photogrammetry and remote sensing. A large amount of recorded material and field data collected in the framework of scientific and professional projects carried out at the Chair are available to students for the preparation of a large number of a diploma thesis in the fields of photogrammetry, remote sensing, and GIS. Many scientific types of research in the field of remote sensing, photogrammetry, and GIS are performed at the Chair, such as:
· developing automatic methods for processing and analyzing satellite and aerial imagery
· development of multisensor systems for close-range and aerial imaging
· development of unmanned aerial vehicles based on open source technologies
· developing new methods for spatial multicriteria analysis for environmental change monitoring
· application of new technologies in the preservation of cultural heritage and 3D modeling
· developing methods for collecting large amounts of spatial data based on active (e.g., laser scanner, radar) and passive sensors (e.g., camera)
· development of new methods for spatial and radiometric camera calibration
· developing methods for processing and analyzing data collected using multispectral, hyperspectral and thermal cameras
· application of terrestrial and aerial laser scanners for spatial data acquisition
· developing methods for processing large amounts of 3D data
· development of algorithms and software solutions in the service of photogrammetry, remote sensing, and GIS
· development of desktop and web GIS solutions for the purpose of performing analyzes and visualization of environmental changes
· developing and expanding the applicability of photogrammetry, remote sensing and GIS to related technical, as well as biotechnical, natural, social, humanistic and interdisciplinary scientific fields.
Scientific research and development of methods, algorithms and software solutions at the Chair is based on the available open-source programs, function libraries and programming languages such as Python, R, etc.

entityDescription:
Neutelings Riedijk Architects is a leading international architectural practice based in Rotterdam, The Netherlands. We offer a strong commitment to design excellence: realizing high quality architecture through the development of powerful and innovative concepts into clear built form.
PUBLIC BUILDINGS & MIXED-USE DEVELOPMENTS
Neutelings Riedijk Architects is specialized in the design of complex projects for public, commercial and cultural buildings. We have designed and built theatres, city halls, museums, libraries, hotels, schools, office buildings and mixed-use developments. We have wide experience in balancing the complex functions and logistics of these projects with their often delicate and urban contexts to give them the iconic significance in the public realm that their clients desire.
ORNAMENT & IDENTITY
In our belief, contemporary ornamentation results in buildings with a powerful expression that create new local identities in a globalized world. In 2018 we published the book ‘Ornament & Identity’, a multi-layered essay that presents the results of our search for expression and identity through a selection of thirty-six of our projects.
TEAM
Neutelings Riedijk Architects was founded in 1987 by Willem Jan Neutelings and Michiel Riedijk. Since 2020 the office is led by principal architect Michiel Riedijk and managing director Carl Meeusen.
We have an international team of talented, highly educated and motivated architects. For our international projects the work force at our office in Rotterdam is complemented by technical expertise through our association with local partners specializing in architectural engineering, cost calculation and site supervision. This arrangement allows us to put together a team of specialists to meet the specific requirements of each project.

Aries provides a unique genetic fingerprint to secure the historical, artistic and productive excellences.
Aries S.r.l. is a Spin Off of the University of Ca’ Foscari in Venice, founded in 2014 with the aim to develop services based on molecular biology applied to artistic and industrial materials. 
The idea to build authentication system based on synthetic DNA (rewarded in 2014 Start Cup) was born from the involvement of different scientific expertise, with the purpose to develop innovative anti-counterfeit technology applicable to artistic, historical and collectible goods. 
Aries strength lies in the multidisciplinary of its research and development team. 
Biologist, engineers and experts in the materials and conservation of cultural heritage are increasingly concerned to improve the services and the industrialisation of the method , that could be applied in fields such as agri-food, pharmaceutical, luxury, fashion and design.

Radarmetrics is a young company but an experienced partner. It treasures more than 15 years known-how in spaceborne (and airborne) radar remote sensing, always working with the main private and institutional actors in Earth Observation around the world. Our core technical skills are in the Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) systems and technologies but we have also significant experience in SAR Altimetry, GNSS-R, and Weather Radars. Our vision is to provide affordable and reliable imaging radars to advance the science of understanding our planet, monitor our resources, and make a safer world. 

Radarmetrics provides end-to-end engineering of imaging radar concepts, including:
- Definition of Innovative Earth Observation Concepts
- Instrument Design
- Performance Estimation
- Systems Engineering
- Proof-of-Concept Demonstrators

entityDescription:
Innovation Centre Nikola Tesla (ICENT) is a non-profit institution whose function is to enable and accelerate efficient commercialization of new technologies in areas critical for the development of Croatian economy. It aims to become the leading Croatian research and development centre in fields of engineering, particularly of electronics, design, computer engineering, and information and communication technology and related applications that drives the Croatian economy towards competitiveness and sustainability. The strengths and capabilities of ICENT are built trough creation of: path for the scientific community to commercialize results of research, growth in interdisciplinary activities within the community, workspace and infrastructure for proof-of-concept and prototypes development, support to start-up companies to commercialize innovations developed, growth of intellectual property, growth of high-added value businesses and jobs, support of technological competitiveness, adding value to the European technological development thrust. 
ICENT is the host of Croatian Robotics Digital Innovation Hub (CROBOHUB), the key Croatian non-profit facility to support companies to become more competitive by improving their business/production processes as well as products and services by up-taking digital technologies and robotic solutions http://www.icent.hr/en/crobohub/.
CROBOHUB DIH acts as one-stop-shop, helping Croatian companies to digitalise their business through efficient orchestrating of various stakeholders in innovation ecosystem such as research institutions, business support institutions and businesses that may contribute to the development and application of advanced robotic systems in manufacturing. CROBOHUB also provides connections with investors, facilitates access to financing for digital transformations, help connect users and suppliers of robotic innovations across the value chain and foster synergies between digital and other key enabling technologies (such as biotech, advanced materials, etc.).
Through its project activities CROBOHUB became a part of network of DIHs and CCs developed by HORSE, L4MS, DIH2 and AI DIH NETWORK projects. It is also part of the EC S3 online catalogue of digital innovation hubs that contains comprehensive information on digital innovation hubs in Europe http://s3platform.jrc.ec.europa.eu/digital-innovation-hubs-tool/-/dih/1474/view.

The Aviation division of FERCHAU GmbH and RST Rostock System-Technik GmbH together form the FERCHAU Aviation Group. As the "Preferred Supplier for Engineering & Customer Services" of the Airbus Group and as a reliable development partner for the European aerospace and defense industries, we offer holistic engineering services for complex aerospace and defense systems.
In addition, the FERCHAU Aviation Group supplies airlines and training centers worldwide with cabin simulators and training solutions, is a certified manufacturer of cable harnesses and automatic test and check-out systems, and is active as a production partner for mechanical and electrical ground equipment for numerous space programs.
Due to our high quality standards, the efficient and flexible cooperation and the comprehensive mix of skills, our experts are increasingly in demand in projects in other branches of industry. The combination of development and consulting services with the possibilities of production, qualification and marketing makes the FERCHAU Aviation Group an ideal “end-to-end” partner for demanding innovation projects.

entityDescription:
Axon Vibe’s customer-centric Smart Mobility Platform/App understands and predicts real-world door-to-door customer behaviour by leveraging 24/7 smartphone location/motion data in a non-intrusive and GDPR-compliant way.
We help public transport operators and authorities to:
1. deliver proactive real-time travel assistance across all modes (e.g. handling disruptions, service changes, social distancing) to re-build confidence in public transport in the "new normal",
2. connect their customers real-world experiences with shared mobility services and commercial eco-systems around them to generate ancillary revenue through delightful contextual marketing campaigns, and
3. gather door-to-door, multi-modal customer behaviour insights and identify real-world usage/demand of their transportation infrastructure (rail and road) to optimise existing or launch new (first/last mile) services.
By predicting customers’ upcoming journeys based on their travel patterns, we anticipate upcoming pain points of individual customers in advance (e.g. disruptions, crowded vehicles/stations) and propose alternative services including active travel, shared mobility and mass public transport in the right context.
By delivering a smart, integrated and seamless navigation system we make the use of public transport and shared mobility as convenient as using a private car.

- manage the Spare Parts Warehouse and the Services in general connected to it

- manage the complete "Document Management Process"
- monitor in real time faults and productivity data automatically detected by the field.

entityDescription:
MVRDV was founded in 1993 by Winy Maas, Jacob van Rijs and Nathalie de Vries. Based in Rotterdam, the Netherlands, we have a global scope, providing solutions to contemporary architectural and urban issues in all regions of the world. Our highly collaborative, research-based design method involves clients, stakeholders, and experts from a wide range of fields from early on in the creative process. The results are exemplary, outspoken projects that enable our cities and landscapes to develop towards a better future.
The work of MVRDV is exhibited and published worldwide and has received numerous international awards. Two hundred and fifty architects, designers and urbanists develop projects in a multi-disciplinary, collaborative design process that involves rigorous technical and creative investigation.
